# Two-column test PDFs

These files are **not part of the application** and are not compiled,
imported or linked by PDF-Advanced-Reader. They are unmodified, openly
licensed research articles kept as real-world fixtures for the reflow
reading-order tests (`tests/test_reflow.py`) and for manual testing with
`Ctrl+R`.

All four works are licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/),
which permits redistribution provided the authors are credited and the
license is indicated. Copyright remains with the respective authors; the
license notice for each article is also printed inside its PDF.

No changes were made to the downloaded files. Retrieved 2026-10-25.

## Adding more fixtures

Only add papers whose license **explicitly permits redistribution** (for
example CC BY, CC BY-SA or public domain) and record the title, authors,
source, license and retrieval date here. PMC, ScienceDirect and
ResearchGate articles are usually publisher-copyrighted: read them for
testing purposes if you wish, but do not commit those files to this
repository.
